sources.entry: Mealie - Material design inspired recipe manager with category and tag management, shopping-lists, meal-planner, and site customizations. Mealie is focused on simple user interactions to keep the whole family using the app. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Python
Mealie | Recipe manager and meal planner

summary.one_liner: Mealie is a self-hosted recipe manager, meal planner, and shopping list app with a REST API backend and a Vue frontend.
summary.what_it_does: Mealie imports recipes by pasting a URL, pulling in the relevant data automatically, or lets users enter a recipe manually in a UI editor. It includes a meal planner for scheduling what to cook over the coming week. Its shopping list can group ingredients into sections matching a local supermarket. Recipes can be grouped into cookbooks based on user-defined criteria. The project provides an API for third-party applications, and the README says translations exist for 35+ languages.
use_cases: import recipes from a website URL
build a grocery shopping list from recipe ingredients
self-host a recipe app with Docker
how_to_run: Deploy with Docker (see the documentation for the Docker setup)
Pull the image from the GitHub Container Registry (ghcr) or Docker Hub as linked in the README
Read the documentation site for configuration and install details
notable: Imports recipes from a URL by automatically extracting the relevant data
Shopping list organized into sections matching a local supermarket
Translations for 35+ languages, managed through Crowdin
Provides an API for third-party applications
Material design inspired interface aimed at the whole family
caveats: The README does not state platform limits, paid tiers, or maintenance status
Contributing to the code requires the nightly documentation and VSCode Dev Containers setup described in the contributors guide
keywords: plan what to cook this week
